instruction: Use a Fusion 360 API script or command-line automation workflow for Fusion-compatible CAM generation. Write the output file(s) to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-25.nc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\tools_used.csv, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-25_setup.html.
